title: Two For The Price of One

[00:15.14] He had what you might call
[00:16.76] a trivial occupation
[00:19.46] He cleaned the platforms
[00:20.81] of the local railway station
[00:23.79] With no romance in his life

[00:35.95] different ages

[00:42.16] When something special he read
[00:46.22] This is what it said:
[00:50.54] If you dream of the girl for you

[01:40.81] "Alice Whiting"

[01:49.19] The purest streak of gold he'd struck
